description: Convert a reference list between BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON and plain text (a simple reference list style, APA by default, or MLA or IEEE when you pass style). The input format is detected unless you pass it. Page ranges, DOIs and names are cleaned on the way. Example: text is a BibTeX entry and to is "ris", and output is the same reference as RIS. Set from only to override detection.

from.description: The format of the text. Defaults to auto, which looks at the text to decide.

style.description: The citation style for the text output: apa, mla or ieee. Defaults to apa. Ignored for the other formats.

text.description: The reference list as text: BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON.

name: convert_bibliography
title: Convert a bibliography
